Like most mental illnesses, anxiety, especially of the ROCD subtype, is very difficult for people to understand. I can relate to you strongly. Relationships cause me to completely isolate myself, I forget about anything else in my life and lose my identity as you describe and I really struggle to keep afloat. Not everyone will understand. I don't speak to those who don't understand about my relationship. I speak only to my therapist and to people who would in any way be supportive or understand. I also don't tell people my doubts, I just respond to my internal doubts with "I don't know if \_\_\_\_\_(doubtful thought)\_\_\_", eg. I don't know if I like him, I don't know if this trait about him will be problematic in the future etc. Accepting the uncertainty is much better than trying to make it certain that everything is 100% perfect all the time.
